parent_protocol.inherited: training, kernel, optimizer, initialization, temperature sets, objectives, fit selection, search, confirmation, final fitting, failures; all unchanged

family.name: independent_squeezed_parity
family.encoder: P(t) [S(r)|+>^15 (x) |+>], P(t)=exp[-i (t/2) sum_{i<16} Z_i Z_16], S(r)=exp[i r (JyJz+JzJy)/15] on the 15 leaves; sin t = tanh(a beta^2), r = -kappa beta cos t; r=0 and t=a beta give the parity encoder at scale a
family.kappa_policy: fixed design constant from the development-only design pass, not searched
family.beta_scale_policy: beta_scale is the schedule constant a, searched log-uniformly on [0.3, 0.7]; it is not in the parity encoder's units, so the parent range does not apply
family.search_space: shared_parity learning_rate, init_scale, b1, one_minus_beta2, schedule and kernel_pair with the parent ranges and priors; beta_scale on beta_scale_range
family.ansatz: complete one- and two-body, 136 phases, no ancillas
family.role: temperature-specific baseline for shared_squeezed_parity: one circuit fitted directly at each marker temperature 0.4, 1.0, 2.0, as independent_parity is for shared_parity

randomness.fit_streams: parent namespace cw-parity-hpo-followup-20261009 and keys; fit streams pair with the independent_parity fits at every stage, repeat, marker and start
randomness.sampler_keys: (sampler, independent_squeezed_parity, random|tpe) in the parent namespace; independent of the samplers

development_history: encoder, kappa and beta_scale range identical to cw_squeezed_protocol.json; no separate design pass
stages: random 60 -> TPE 60 -> confirmation (3-4 candidates, 5 repeats x 3 starts) -> final (10 repeats x 3 starts)
execution: fits may be sharded across machines with identical source identity; recording, Optuna ask/tell and selection run once on the primary workspace
